QuestInfo.name: Friendly Relationship
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Neinheart and hand over the letter of introduction from Beldar.
QuestInfo.1: You handed the letter of introduction from Beldar to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.2: It seems you succeeded in forming a friendly relationship with the Cygnus Knights.

1.msg: #b(You have to talk to this pompous guy any time you need Maple World info? He seems obnoxious.)#k

2.msg: Hero of justice? What an interesting introduction.

3.msg: I heard about some of your exploits. I never imagined that you were from Grandis...

yes.0: We need power. Power to fight the Black Mage. The righteous and strong are always welcome among us. I believe this is a good opportunity for the both of us.

1.0: I'll contact you when I have a request or information to give you. For now, I'll take my leave.

0.msg: #b(It seems a connection has been formed with the Cygnus Knights. I'll be able to get information now...)

default.0: You must be the champion Beldar spoke so highly of. Wait a moment.
